name: Sunscale Dragon - Adult
description: Adult Sunscale is a neutral-leaning firmament intelligent true dragon with violet scales that kindle molten gold in sunlight. It seeks to test mortals through riddles, wagers, and fire. At this age it is a commanding force in its territory.

attacks.name: Molten Jaws
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 3 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Sunlit Fury
abilities.description: In direct sunlight, the dragon gains +2 Difficulty and adds 2 to damage from its attacks.

abilities.name: Solar Breath
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 18. On a failure, take 3d8+6 magic damage and clinging solar fire forces the target to mark 1 Stress. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Flare Wing
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Make an attack against every enemy within Very Close range. Each success deals 3d8+6 physical damage and knocks the target back to Close range.

abilities.name: Solar Reprisal
abilities.description: When the dragon marks HP from an attack within Close range, mark a Stress to make a Solar Breath attack against that attacker if it remains in range.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
